summary: @servicetitan/skeleton preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs', which auto-fires on npm install. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods it 0755 in a temp directory, and invokes the dropped binary via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB script with a @bun/@bun-cjs header, string-array rotation (function WV8StW shifting constant array n7gIxM), a custom base-N decoder with the alphabet 'm)!%*evKO9r=2XcRL&(G]HJ3@S5>~:U^Q[...]', and no readable logic or source map. The advertised main entry (dist/index.js) is a 34-byte stub, so the sole install-time behavior of this package is the alternate-runtime dropper. The package is published under the @servicetitan scope with homepage docs.st.dev and repo github.com/servicetitan/application-ui.git, but its content is inconsistent with an enterprise UI-skeleton library, indicating a compromised publish or scope impersonation. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code and results in arbitrary attacker-controlled code executing on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
